Policies

Plain answers to the questions customers ask most.

Shipping

Delivery

  • Orders ship within 2 working days after we confirm them.
  • We send a tracking link when your order ships.
  • Cash on delivery is available. We confirm these orders by call or message first.
  • We deliver across India. Shipping is free.
Returns

Damaged or faulty

If your bottle arrives broken, leaking or not working, tell us within 48 hours of delivery.

  • Send a photo or short video of the problem to our phone or email.
  • We replace the bottle, or refund you, at no cost.
  • Refunds go back to the original payment method within 7 working days.

Report a problem

Within 48 hours of delivery. We reply within 1 working day.

After you submit, we'll ask for a photo or short video on your phone number.

Privacy

Your details

We use your name, phone number and address only to deliver your order and confirm it with you.

  • We never sell your details.
  • We keep order records for as long as the law requires.
  • To ask us to delete your details, contact us using the details below.
